description: Analyzes a pricing strategy end to end - current pricing baseline, competitive price positioning, pricing model and value metric fit, willingness-to-pay signals, packaging, revenue scenarios, and a migration plan - and produces a pricing recommendation. Use when current pricing is losing deals or leaving money on the table; launching or restructuring pricing tiers; running an annual pricing review; moving to usage-based or outcome-based pricing; or pricing an Artificial Intelligence (AI) product.
